content.name: Bethany Clarke
content.title: HR Assistant
content.summary: Human resource management graduate from UWE Bristol with a year-long placement and a first permanent HR role at a care home group. Supports 600 staff across nine homes with onboarding and DBS checks, and cut the average time to clear a new starter from 26 days to 15.

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Coordinate onboarding for around 25 new care staff a month across nine homes, including DBS checks and right-to-work checks.
Cut the average time from offer to start date from 26 to 15 days by chasing references and DBS applications on a shared tracker.
Prepare letters and notes for absence and disciplinary meetings, and take minutes at formal hearings.
Keep 600 employee records accurate in Breathe HR and run a monthly report of expiring training.

experience.title: HR Placement Student
bullets: Answered about 40 HR queries a week from a 350-strong workforce on pay, holiday and policies.
Helped run the apprentice recruitment campaign, screening 210 applications for 12 places.
Built an exit-interview summary in Excel that showed shift patterns were the top reason for leaving.
